title: Jeff DeGrandis DragFink Signed Limited Edition Print 8/10 - Hot Rod Art
descriptionText:
Own a piece of wild hot rod cartoon history! This is a limited edition, hand-signed and numbered art print (8 of only 10 ever made) by Jeff DeGrandis, featuring his iconic DragFink artwork -- an homage to the legendary Rat Fink style by Ed 'Big Daddy' Roth.

This piece features:
A crazed cartoon driver in a blown dragster
Text and elements such as 'Fats McGurk' and 'Lions Drag Strip'
Signed 'DeGrandis 8/10' in the lower right
'DragFink.com' and 'Direct From California!' branding

The artwork is full of classic hot rod culture details, including wheelies, smoke trails, and exaggerated cartoon features. A must-have for fans of custom culture, lowbrow art, or Rat Fink memorabilia.

Dimensions (Approximate): Print size 11in x 14in. Comes in a protective plastic sleeve with a red and black mat-style border (as shown in photos).

Condition: Excellent. Stored flat in a protective sleeve, with no visible creases or damage to the artwork.
